subject: MAP: Close-week play — SOC 2 / SIG & DPA retention decision
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@montec.com>, Procurement <procure@montec.com>
Cc: Montec Legal <legal@montec.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Close-week play — SOC 2 / SIG & DPA retention decision

Hi Elena / team,

Thanks for the call this morning — appreciate the quick feedback. Per our MAP (attached v3), I want to lock the acceptance lane for security so we can hit the close target next Friday. Key asks from Montec we need to confirm this week: 

1) SOC 2: Montec requested an attestation / report. Option A: Redwood will provide our latest SOC 2 Type II report (scope: hosting & processing) within 10 business days of PO. Option B: if procurement needs pre-sign evidence, we can share the SOC 2 attestation stub and arrange a short security Q&A with our SOC owner this week.

2) SIG / CAIQ: We will complete the CAIQ baseline answers for shared-controls within 5 business days; a full SIG export will take ~15 business days. If Montec has must-have SIG questions for the pilot, flag them and we'll prioritize.

3) DPA & retention: Attached is our DPA redline (DPA-redline-Montec.docx). Proposed default: 24 months retention for application data; 90 days for logs and telemetry. For EU residency requirement we can offer a 12-month retention variant and EU-hosted logs at the Dedicated / Private tier.

Next steps I propose: legal and security confirmation by EOD Thu (20 Jun), Redwood to submit updated CAIQ + SOC2 stub by Fri morning, and we push DocuSign for the DPA on Monday. If those timelines work for you, I will schedule a 30-minute alignment call Thursday (09:30 PT).

Attachments: Montec-MAP-v3.xlsx, SOC2-attestation-stub.pdf, DPA-redline-Montec.docx

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

---

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@montec.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Montec Legal <legal@montec.com>, Procurement <procure@montec.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Close-week play — SOC 2 / SIG & DPA retention decision

Thanks Kim — quick clarifying items from legal/security before we can commit to the timelines:

• SOC 2 scope: We need confirmation that SOC 2 Type II covers processing of customer content (not just control plane). Is production inference included?
• Backup & deletion: For the 24-month retention, what is your deletion guarantee for backups and snapshots? We need a timeline for removal from cold storage after deletion request.
• Logs: Can you confirm what telemetry is retained (IP, prompts, embeddings, raw outputs)? We may need a narrower retention window for PII-sensitive prompts.

If Redwood can confirm production inference is in-scope and provide an ETA for backup purge (post-delete), Montec Legal should be comfortable with the 24-month baseline. We are also evaluating the 12-month EU-only option if there are hosting constraints.

Also, please send the CAIQ answer set and the SOC2 stub so our security team can triage tonight.

Elena Ruiz
Head of Product Security, Montec Financial
elena.ruiz@montec.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@montec.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Montec Legal <legal@montec.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 12:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Close-week play — SOC 2 / SIG & DPA retention decision

Elena — looping in a couple specifics so we’re aligned on commitments and timelines: 

1) SOC 2 coverage: Redwood confirms SOC 2 Type II report includes production inference service (data processing) — our controls map to in-scope systems used by customers for inference. I attached the SOC2-attestation-stub for your review. If you need the full report before signature, we can: (a) provide a redacted report under an NDA, or (b) proceed with the stub + a short security interview and supply the full report within 10 business days of PO.

2) Backup purge: Standard procedure — when a customer requests deletion, application-layer data is removed within 7 days; backups and snapshots are purged on a 30–45 day rolling schedule unless the SOW requires longer retention. For EU data residency/API options, we can tighten the backup purge to 30 days with a contractual clause.

3) Logs & telemetry: Default retention — 90 days for aggregated telemetry; 7 days for raw request payloads unless customer elects longer retention. We can scope sensitive prompts to be excluded from logs via a 'no-logging' flag for pilot requests.

4) SIG/CAIQ delivery cadence: Redwood will push CAIQ baseline answers tonight and prioritize any top-10 customer questions to be completed within 3 business days (not the full SIG export). Full SIG available within 15 business days if requested.

5) DPA redlines: Kimberly, I reviewed the attached redline. We are comfortable with 24 months as the standard; however Montec’s EU residency request is manageable — offer a 12-month variant with EU log residency at Private tier. Please confirm which variant Procurement prefers and we’ll flip the DocuSign envelope.

If Montec can confirm scope and pick the retention variant by EOD Thu we will have everything to push to legal and finalize a signature path next week.

Thanks — Jordan Blake
VP, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0127

• Thu, 20 Jun (EOD): Montec to confirm SOC2 scope acceptance and choose retention variant (24mo standard or 12mo EU-only).
• Fri, 21 Jun (09:00 PT): Redwood to submit prioritized SIG Q&A for the 10 highest-impact items Montec flags.
• Mon, 24 Jun: DocuSign envelope for DPA + PO routing (assuming acceptance).

I’ve attached the DPA redline we’ll send to signers (DPA-redline-Montec.docx) and the MAP workbook (Montec-MAP-v3.xlsx). If legal wants a redacted SOC2 before signing, we can provide it under the mutual NDA and will commit to delivering the full report within 10 business days post-PO.
